meta_description: Ashley Landscaping is your Southampton landscape gardener. Garden design, patios, fencing, and maintenance. Free quotes. Call 07546 335805.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning outdoor spaces—we design and build gardens that work for you.
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign or seasonal maintenance, we handle every aspect of outdoor space creation and care.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Custom layouts tailored to your budget and lifestyle. We assess drainage, sunlight, and soil to create a garden that thrives for years.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Porcelain, natural stone, and block paving installations. Perfectly levelled surfaces with integrated drainage—built to last.

services.title: Fencing & Boundaries
services.desc: Timber, composite, and metal fencing installed to specifications. We handle removal of old panels and post repairs too.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Strategic plant selection for colour, structure, and low-maintenance appeal. Includes soil preparation and seasonal mulching.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular lawn care, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal tidy-ups. Keep your garden looking sharp without the weekend chore.

services.title: Decking & Structures
services.desc: Bespoke garden decks, raised beds, and pergolas. Built with treated timber to withstand the New Forest climate.

about_pullquote: I build gardens people actually use and love tending—not Instagram snapshots that fall apart.
about_para_1: Ashley Landscaping was born from a simple frustration: watching neighbours settle for mediocre garden work at inflated prices. For over 15 years, we've designed and built outdoor spaces across Southampton and the wider South Coast, working directly with homeowners to turn rough plots into thriving, usable gardens. Our approach combines practical horticulture with honest project management—no upselling, no corner-cutting.
about_para_2: We've earned our reputation through reliability and attention to detail. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and personal referrals, because people trust us to deliver what we promise. Whether you need a complete garden overhaul or regular seasonal care, we treat your outdoor space with the same care we'd give our own homes.

reviews.text: Couldn't believe the difference when Ashley's team finished. We had a bog of a back garden, overgrown for years. They cleared it, installed the patio we wanted, and planted borders with lovely shrubs. Professional, tidy, and the price was fair. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Had Ashley out for a free quote on fencing. He gave sensible advice about what would work with our slope and drainage. Turned down the upsell on decking we didn't need. Did the fence job properly—post repairs, new panels, all level. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Been using Ashley for three years now for spring and autumn garden maintenance. Always reliable, reasonable rates, and he spots problems before they become expensive. My garden looks great without me having to lift a finger.
reviews.author: Claire W.

address_sub: Serving Southampton, Totton, Hythe, and surrounding New Forest areas
